name: Experiential Labs
notes: Experiential Labs (Resolute Labs AI, Inc.) is a router that sells hundreds of models from many upstreams behind one xpl_ API key, paid from prepaid credits. It is modelled as pay-as-you-go at base list prices: Cost is the price of each model's first platform-funded route in its default waterfall, from the public catalog GET /api/models (nano-USD per million tokens, converted to USD per million, retrieved 2026-11-28). A request that falls through to a later route can be billed at that route's rate, and launch promotions (such as HY4 Flash at 50% off) are not reflected. The Pro, Max and Ultra subscriptions lower prices or include daily free allowances; they are not modelled, and neither are the bring-your-own-key routes or the plan-account lanes that pool ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions. Terms 4.2.1(viii) forbids reselling access; it is not flagged Terms Risk, because Experiential Labs publishes its inference URL for direct use. Three chat endpoints serve every model: chat completions and Responses under /v1, and Anthropic Messages, which takes x-api-key or Bearer (send exactly one). No API key was available, so each was checked live only with a fake key, which answered 401 invalid_key in the documented shape on all three (an unknown path answers 404 not_found); the Provider ships unverified until a real request succeeds. Claude models list Anthropic Messages first and GPT and o-series models list Responses first (ADR 0095); the others use chat completions. An empty credit balance, and a model that needs payment or a purchase, answer 429 insufficient_quota, which Experiential Labs says not to retry, so it marks the Provider Account Exhausted; a plain 429 rate_limit_exceeded (with Retry-After) stays a Cooldown. 402 free_tier_requires_payment and card_required, 403 model_not_granted and 502 all_routes_failed are ordinary failures. Cached tokens are reported on chat completions (prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens) and on Anthropic Messages (cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens); the cache write price is the 5-minute one, and it is left empty where the catalog has none. Long-context prices are in each model's notes only, so Cost understates very long prompts; the OpenAI flex and priority service tiers some models offer are not modelled. Release dates are the day each model was first released by any Provider, copied from the original Provider's Catalog file where one exists, else as Experiential Labs lists them, else from models.dev; uncensored variants take the day Experiential Labs first listed them. The model list comes only from the public catalog. Shipped: every model with text in and text out that has an active, priced, platform-funded route, uncensored variants included. Not shipped: models reachable only through a customer's own key, batch-only -batch models (the Batches API has no Protocol here), the decision models with no output price (Clef, Clef Flash, GPT-6 Luna Decisions, Gemini Decision 1, Jev), free-only use through the :free suffix, and embeddings, rerank, image, audio, transcription and video models, which have no Protocol in the gateway (nor does the Gemini protocol).
